summaries.opena2a-org-hackmyagent: HackMyAgent is a TypeScript security scanner and red-team toolkit for AI agents, part of the OpenA2A ecosystem. It runs 209 static checks, 29 semantic analyses via NanoMind AST, and 164 adversarial payloads to detect credentials, prompt injection, MCP misconfigs, and agent vulnerabilities. Marked stable at v0.23.5 with 32 commits in the last month and 27 open todos, mostly release and documentation tasks.
